name: Danish Power Ltd
about: Founded in July 1985, Danish Power Limited manufactures various types of transformers, including inverter duty transformers for use in renewable power projects such as solar power plants and wind farms. [1]
keyPoints:
Business Profile[1]
Danish Power Limited specializes in manufacturing power and distribution transformers. The company serves industries including renewable energy, commercial power plants, and utilities.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 100% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 34.3%
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 59.7 to 80.8 days.
Working capital days have increased from 57.1 days to 98.6 days
